originality.rationale: The primary paper establishes general upward closure and minimum-total-quota profiles, but not the full set of componentwise minima at unanimous preference or the exact Eulerian-tail enumeration of all successful variable-quota strategies. Both implications were checked against full material in its Sections 4--8. The Eulerian recurrence is known, but its explicit identification with the parking strategy statistic is distinct. Search found no stronger covering theorem; unindexed sources remain a risk.

value.rationale: The original model highlights complete minimal elements and permutation linkage as open. This natural unanimous-preference class admits full upset classification rather than just a minimizer, exponentially many minimal elements in the central regime, an Eulerian probability law for all n!, and a complete bijection; nonconstant words remain outside scope.
